title: Adaptive AI Assistant
subtitle: AI • Prompt Engineering • Evaluation
description: Built and iterated LLM-powered workflows for leaning assistant: prompt + rubric design, structured outputs, evaluation criteria, and quality analysis against real user tasks. Focused on reliability, consistency, and measurable improvements. (Company project; details are confidential.)

title: Mental Health Demand-Supply Gap Monitor
subtitle: Machine Learning • Dashboard
description: An interactive data-to-dashboard system that tracks mental health demand signals vs provider capacity across U.S. states (2020-2024). Interpretable ML highlights where gaps are largest and what factors drive them.

title: Wallet Wizard - Personal Finance Tracker
subtitle: Full-Stack Development
description: Full-stack personal finance web app with authentication, CRUD budgets/transactions, and a REST API. Built a responsive dashboard in Next.js/React, backed by Node.js services and PostgreSQL for reliable expense tracking and monthly budgeting.

title: NIH Grant Activity Classifier
subtitle: Machine Learning
description: Trained a multi-class model to predict NIH grant activity series (F/T/K/R) from structured award signals using public NIH RePORTER data (FY2018–FY2023, 118k+ records). Best baseline achieved ~0.93 macro-F1 on validation.

title: Test Data Refresh Pipeline
subtitle: Data Engineering
description: Built a data pipeline to consolidate and analyze security-related datasets, enabling faster monitoring and investigation. Emphasized data quality, reproducibility, and scalable processing for downstream analytics.

title: EdTech Support Chatbot
subtitle: NLP • LLMs • Systems
description: Built a modular EdTech support chatbot (easy → advanced): NLTK rules, intent classification, and an LLM prototype. Compared reliability/latency/maintainability tradeoffs and documented an upgrade path from GPT-2-era prototypes to modern LLMs with guardrails.
